title: Signature Modules and the Dihedral Conjugation-Quandle Counting Invariant
summary: We use reflection and rotation signatures of dihedral groups to develop a Smith normal form method for computing the conjugation quandle colorings across all dihedral groups. Let $L = L_1 \cup \cdots \cup L_\ell$ be a link with link components $L_1, \ldots, L_\ell$, and let $\operatorname{Conj}(D_n)$ be the conjugation quandle of the dihedral group $D_n$. We use the semidirect-product structure $D_n \cong \mathbb{Z}_n \rtimes \mathbb{Z}_2$ to separate the coloring into a component signature. This component signature tells us whether each link component is colored by rotations or reflections,…
